description:
Create migration `004_add_releases.sql` with `releases` and `release_platforms` tables. Add Go types (Release, ReleasePlatform, channel/status constants), repository layer (CRUD + promotion + supersede logic), and handler scaffolding for release history API endpoints.

The supersede step must run in the same transaction as the publish status update: when a new release reaches `published` status for a given (profile, channel), the previous `published` release for that same (profile, channel) is atomically set to `superseded`.

Key schema details:
- `releases` table: UUID PK, profile_id FK, deployment_id FK, profile_version snapshot, git_commit_hash, release_version (semver), channel, status, release_notes, promoted_from_release_id self-FK, timestamps.
- `release_platforms` table: composite PK (release_id, platform), per-platform status tracking, approval_id FK, lpbs_artifact_id correlation, error field.
- Unique constraint: (profile_id, git_commit_hash, channel) on releases.
name: dm-releases-and-release-platforms-tables
title: Add Releases And Release Platforms Tables To Deployment Manager
